title: Back in Stock Alert
content: Build back-in-stock notification feature. Display: replaces "Add to Cart" when out of stock. Form: email input, "Notify Me" button. Variant-specific: if product has variants, specify which variant. Success: "We'll email you when back in stock" confirmation. Already signed up: show subscribed status with option to unsubscribe. Alternative: show similar in-stock products suggestion.

variants.simple: Create back-in-stock notification signup for out-of-stock items.
variants.detailed: Build back-in-stock notification feature. Display: replaces "Add to Cart" when out of stock. Form: email input, "Notify Me" button. Variant-specific: if product has variants, specify which variant. Success: "We'll email you when back in stock" confirmation. Already signed up: show subscribed status with option to unsubscribe. Alternative: show similar in-stock products suggestion.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive back-in-stock notification system. Display trigger: appears when product/variant is out of stock, replaces or supplements disabled "Add to Cart" button. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 or inline form. Out of stock message: "Currently Out of Stock" or "Sold Out" text with warning styling, estimated restock date if available ("Expected back: Late January"). Notification form: "Get notified when back in stock" heading, email input (pre-filled if logged in, placeholder "Enter your email"), "Notify Me" primary button, or compact inline layout (flex gap-2). Variant-specific: if product has multiple variants (size/color), the form captures which specific variant user wants, display selected variant info: "Notify me when Size M / Blue is available", if multiple variants OOS, option to select which to track or "Notify for any". Phone/SMS option: optional phone input for SMS notification (faster), toggle between email/SMS preference. Success state: replaces form with confirmation, check icon with "You're on the list!", "We'll notify you at [email] when [Product - Variant] is back", "Manage Notifications" link to preferences. Already subscribed state: if user already signed up, show "You'll be notified when available" with subscribed status, "Remove" or "Unsubscribe" option. Interest counter: optionally show "{X} people waiting" social proof. Pre-order option: if enabled, offer pre-order while OOS "Pre-order now, ships when available". Alternative products: "Similar items in stock" section showing available alternatives, same category or complementary products. Waitlist position: optionally show user's position in notification queue. Priority access: subscribers might get early notification before general restock announcement. Notification flow: when item restocks, send email with direct link to product, time-limited "Reserved for 24 hours" priority. Management page: user can see all back-in-stock subscriptions, edit or remove each. Suppress for in-stock: automatically hide/disable signup form when item comes back in stock. Rate limiting: one signup per email per product to prevent abuse. Analytics: track notification signups and conversion when restocked. Accessibility: form properly labeled, status changes announced, clear success/error messaging.
